purpose: Fail-closed parcel height-difference sampling contract for parcel_61523 through parcel_61525 after canonical Point extraction.

rows.requirement: Source path must resolve to Git blob bb48164e7a0af78df875f30421a6a3068c43edb8 and the complete stream must be SHA256 hashed.
rows.evidence: v1.1 runner output source object and full-stream metrics

rows.requirement: Exactly one occurrence of parcel_61523, parcel_61524 and parcel_61525 must be observed in canonical order after all 92283 features are parsed.
rows.evidence: v1.1 occurrence counts and observed feature count

rows.requirement: Each canonical feature must be Point geometry with finite longitude and latitude inside valid geographic ranges.
rows.evidence: canonical point output acceptance block

rows.requirement: Transform the validated point to OSGB36 National Grid using the definitive OSTN15 grid; preserve transformation software and grid version in provenance.
rows.evidence: transformation command, version and EPSG identifiers

rows.requirement: Reject simple or approximate Helmert conversion because the official error can reach 3.5 m at 95 percent.
rows.evidence: OS transformation method recorded as OSTN15, not approximate Helmert

rows.requirement: Use the current HMLR polygon release and record release date, local-authority file identity and file checksum.
rows.evidence: HMLR dataset metadata and downloaded file provenance

rows.requirement: When a polygon occurs in adjacent local-authority downloads, deduplicate by stable polygon/title identifiers and identical geometry fingerprint before point matching.
rows.evidence: deduplication audit row

rows.requirement: Select polygons containing or covering the OSTN15-transformed canonical point; multiple candidates require title or identity reconciliation and may not be resolved by nearest distance alone.
rows.evidence: spatial predicate and candidate list

rows.requirement: Open INSPIRE and standard title-plan polygons must be labelled indicative/general boundary, never exact legal boundary.
rows.evidence: boundary_semantics field on every published row

rows.requirement: Claim exact or determined boundary only when title-specific determined-boundary evidence is present and matched to the same parcel identity.
rows.evidence: title-specific evidence reference

rows.requirement: Record the chain from canonical parcel ID to HMLR polygon/title identity; geometry coincidence without identity evidence remains indicative.
rows.evidence: identity reconciliation record

rows.requirement: Query official DTM time-stamped extent layer 0 in EPSG:27700 using the transformed point or matched polygon extent and retain the complete response.
rows.evidence: ArcGIS REST request parameters, response and timestamp

rows.requirement: Prefer an intersecting native time-stamped DTM at 0.25 m, 0.5 m or 1 m; 2 m is accepted only with disclosed resolution downgrade and no better valid tile.
rows.evidence: ranked candidate tile list and selection reason

rows.requirement: Record survey date, source project, product resolution, tile identifier and whether the tile is native or resampled.
rows.evidence: tile catalogue attributes and download metadata

rows.requirement: Record the survey-specific transformation and geoidal model. OSGM02 material requires the official adjustment path before comparison with OSGM15/ODN data.
rows.evidence: metadata fields and adjustment decision

rows.requirement: Primary raster must be aligned to OS National Grid EPSG:27700 and elevations reported in metres relative to the applicable ODN or documented local datum.
rows.evidence: GeoTIFF CRS, vertical datum and units readback

rows.requirement: Reject NoData, non-finite, masked or out-of-coverage cells; fail the parcel when valid coverage does not satisfy the minimum sample contract.
rows.evidence: NoData value, valid-cell count and coverage ratio

rows.requirement: Create an interior sampling polygon buffered inward by max(2 times native cell size, 1.0 m). If the polygon collapses, classify it as too small and use a separately disclosed narrow-parcel protocol rather than silently removing the buffer.
rows.evidence: cell size, buffer distance and resulting area

rows.requirement: Require at least 25 valid native DTM cell centres inside the buffered interior and at least 8 valid boundary-adjacent diagnostic samples distributed around the polygon; otherwise fail closed.
rows.evidence: sample counts and spatial distribution audit

rows.requirement: Compute primary minimum and maximum from native DTM cell-centre values inside the accepted sampling geometry. Interpolated values may be shown only as diagnostics because smoothing can suppress extrema.
rows.evidence: native sample table and interpolation flag

rows.requirement: Query the matching DSM survey and flag cells where DSM minus DTM exceeds 1.0 m. Such cells must not replace bare-earth DTM and trigger building/vegetation review near parcel edges.
rows.evidence: matching DSM identity and difference statistics

rows.requirement: Where available, corroborate extrema and suspicious edge cells against matching-survey classified point-cloud ground returns; mismatched survey dates are diagnostic only.
rows.evidence: point-cloud survey identity and ground-return comparison

rows.requirement: Attach published source RMSE, transformation RMSE and the analytical height-difference envelope. Results at or below the conservative envelope are labelled below-resolution rather than robust.
rows.evidence: uncertainty budget reference and classification

rows.requirement: Publish only when all mandatory gates pass for the same parcel. Include source URLs, release dates, checksums, tile IDs, survey dates, CRS/datum, sample counts, min, max, difference, uncertainty class and every warning.
rows.evidence: row-level publication manifest and readback
